newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Yuen Foong Yu plans T$2.1 bln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Yuen Foong Yu plans T$2.1 bln bond issue.

text.p: Yuen Foong Yu Paper Manufacturing Co, Taiwan's leading paper maker, said on Thursday it would issue T$2.1 billion in unsecured corporate bonds by year-end to raise funds for a financial restructuring.
"We plan to issue the bonds by the end of this year to raise funds to help improve our financial structure," a company spokesman said by telephone.
Three tranches, each of T$700 million, will have terms ranging from five, six and seven years.
The five-year bonds will have a coupon rate of 6.82 percent, the six-year bonds 6.88 percent, and the seven-year bonds 6.96 percent, the spokesman said.
The bonds will pay interest once a year, with principal paid back until maturity, he said.
Grand Cathay Securities will be lead underwriter for the issue, he said.
